ios.desc:
Say it in one sentence: "a site for my yoga studio", "an online store for my clothing brand", "a digital menu for my restaurant", "a habit tracker". wanno writes it, builds it in front of you, and hands you a link that already works.
Type it, say it out loud, or upload a photo to work from.

WHAT YOU CAN BUILD
- Online stores — catalog, product pages, cart
- Landing pages — cover, benefits, contact
- Websites for your business — services, hours, location
- Booking sites — services and calendar
- Digital menus — sections, prices, photos
- Portfolios — project grid and contact
- Event pages — agenda and signup
- Apps — habit trackers, polls, chats, games, calculators
- Slide decks and one-pagers

EDIT BY TOUCH, NOT BY CODE
Tap anything on the page — a headline, a photo, a button, a whole section — and change it right there. Swipe left to delete, swipe right and wanno rewrites it. Undo is always one tap. Or hold the mic and just say what you want different.

RESTYLE WITHOUT STARTING OVER
Ready-made looks, or your own colors and fonts. Change the whole design in one tap — free, and your content stays exactly where it is.

WATCH IT WORK
The preview updates step by step as it builds. Keep typing while it runs — your next requests queue up and go out when the current build ends.

PUBLISH IN ONE TAP
Your project goes live instantly on your own wanno.dev address. Bring your own domain when you're ready — certificate included, DNS set up for you, no monthly fee.

BUILT-IN SECURITY CHECK
Every project is reviewed for common security problems before it goes out, so what you publish is safe to share.

FEEDBACK WITHOUT ACCOUNTS
Send a private review link. Anyone can open it and point at exactly what they mean — no signup on their end, and they can't change your work. Comments land in your review inbox and you decide what to act on.

START FROM THE COMMUNITY
Showcase is full of real projects built in wanno. Open one you like and remix it into your own.

EVERYTHING IN ONE PLACE
Project status, visits, credit balance and feedback, all in the same app.

Start free.
